Name: Oira no Ski
Tags: Comedy, Sports, Animal Protagonists, Black and White, No Dialogue, Non-Human Protagonists, Shorts
Description: The sun rises, but snow begins to fall immediately. Two rabbits wearing skis emerge from two houses covered in snow. The two rabbits go to wake Tanuko, the sleepy raccoon dog, and invite him to go skiing. Tanuko, who does not know how to ski, is apprehensive at first, but decides to take up the challenge after watching the rabbits skillfully ski down the slope.
